Class IrSolutionMap

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.ir.compiler.IrSolutionMap
public class IrSolutionMap extends Object
Maps IR non-constant variables to their translated Choco variables. IR variables can be optimized away. The get<Type>Var methods will return either the constant it optimized to or the Choco variable. The get<Type>Value will return the value, regardless of the optimizations. The get<Type>Value methods are undefined if the solver has not found a solution yet.

jimmy
